Charlotte Dental Associates — SEO audit

Four clear fixes, with exact scope and evidence.

01

Business and article schema use stale values

The homepage Dentist schema lists the old address and Friday hours, 57 Article headlines are numeric, and two doctor bios incorrectly use Service markup.

  • Change Dentist address to 8401 University Executive Park Dr, Suite 120 and Friday to closed; replace the two old-address mentions in llms.txt.
  • Use current article titles for the 57 Article headlines and verified Person/ProfilePage identity for the two bio nodes; keep the seven treatment Service graphs.
02

Animated images keep transferring large files

The 42.5 MB CSS hero transferred 13.7–16.9 MB without finishing in 30-second browser observations; the separate 56 MB team animation is already lazy-loaded below the fold.

  • Use an approved lightweight video/still and mobile poster for the hero, preserving quality and visual intent.
  • Optimize the selected team-slider variant in the existing optimization sheet; keep its lazy loading and tracking.
03

Older blog pages point search to page one

Blog archive pages 2–6 contain different older articles but all declare /blog/ as their canonical URL.

  • Give each real archive page its own canonical URL using the five exact corrections below.
  • Keep working article links and pagination; retain the page-one redirect.

04

An obsolete sitemap remains in Search Console

Search Console retains category-sitemap1.xml with one fetch error, and the obsolete file returns HTTP 404 while the current sitemap works.

  • Remove only the obsolete category-sitemap1.xml submission after confirming it is retired; do not restore an unnecessary feed.
  • Keep sitemaps.xml and the healthy page/post feeds; do not remove articles or redirect the current index.

Fix order

Correct hidden office/article data, reduce the proven animation transfer, then clean archive canonicals and the obsolete submission.

  • Website: one schema/identity package, approved media alternatives and five canonical corrections.
  • SEO: remove only the obsolete GSC submission; reconcile existing optimization/content work before ticket creation.

Keep approved forms, financing, phone tracking and current work; large-media transfer is not the measured text LCP.
